name: traveltok-ai
description: TravelTok AI - Analytics & AI Content Planner for travel TikTok content

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run start:dev -w @traveltok/api" "npm run start:worker:dev -w @traveltok/api"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @traveltok/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run start:worker:dev -w @traveltok/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @traveltok/api && npm run build -w @traveltok/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @traveltok/database && npm run build -w @traveltok/ai
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run test:e2e -w @traveltok/api
